data.measurement_model: Each independent observation is y_ij=theta_j-theta_i+error_ij in seconds. Every listed existing pair has one observation. Select exactly one independent additional observation of one listed candidate pair; even a repeated pair adds its independent precision rather than replacing an existing observation.
data.noise_protocol: Errors have zero mean and are mutually uncorrelated, including the future candidate observation. All strictly positive variances are stipulated known design quantities. No Gaussian distribution is needed for the requested best linear unbiased estimator variance. There are no physical absolute clock anchors.
data.coordinate_protocol: Node labels identify the same unknowns across pairs. For numerical arrays retain node_order unless a consistent labelled basis conversion is explicitly tracked. One gauge may be fixed to compute an identifiable relative contrast; fixing an unrelated gauge in each disconnected component does not identify a contrast between components.
